segments.tha-ap532:1.3: Kassapo nāma gottena [nāmena (sabbattha)], uppajji vadataṃ varo.
segments.tha-ap532:4.3: Ākāso viya paññāya, asaṅgo anilo yathā.
segments.tha-ap532:7.3: Addasaṃ virajaṃ buddhaṃ, desentaṃ amataṃ padaṃ.
segments.tha-ap532:13.1: “Esa so bhagavā buddho, esa sīho anuttaro;
segments.tha-ap532:14.1: “Danto dametā santo ca, sametā nibbuto isi;
segments.tha-ap532:15.1: “Vīro sūro ca vikkanto [dhīro ca (sī. pī.)], pañño kāruṇiko vasī;
segments.tha-ap532:15.3: Vijitāvī ca sa jino, appagabbo anālayo.
segments.tha-ap532:16.3: Dhorayho usabho nāgo, sīho sakko garūsupi.
segments.tha-ap532:17.3: Akhilo ca visallo ca, asamo saṃyato [vusabho (syā.), payato (pī.)] suci.
segments.tha-ap532:18.3: Yodho buddho sutāsuto [suto suto (sī. pī.)], acalo mudito sito [dito (sī.)].
segments.tha-ap532:19.1: “Dhātā dhatā ca santi ca, kattā netā pakāsitā;
segments.tha-ap532:19.3: Sampahaṃsitā bhettā ca, chettā sotā pasaṃsitā.
segments.tha-ap532:20.3: Anejo virajo kattā, gandhā vattā pasaṃsitā.
segments.tha-ap532:21.3: Pāpetā sahitā kantā, hantā ātāpī tāpaso [hantā, tāpitā ca visositā (syā.)].
segments.tha-ap532:24.3: Tasmā buddhe ca dhamme ca, saṅghe saddhā mahatthikā [mahiddhikā (sī. ka.)].
segments.tha-ap532:26.3: Tato cuto manussesu, jāto homi sugandhiko.
segments.tha-ap532:27.3: Sedagandho ca satataṃ, sabbagandhova hoti me [sabbagandhotiseti me (sī. pī.)].
segments.tha-ap532:28.3: Parisanto [ādisanto (sī.), atikanto (syā.), atisanto (pī.)] sadā vāti, sarīro ca tatheva me.
segments.tha-ap532:30.1: “Guṇaṃ buddhassa vatvāna, hitāya ca na sadisaṃ [hitāya janasandhisu (sī. pī.), hitāya naṃ sukhāvahaṃ (syā.)];
segments.tha-ap532:31.3: Vattā aparibhūto ca, niddoso paññavā tathā.
segments.tha-ap532:32.3: Tesaṃ hetuṃ pavakkhāmi, taṃ suṇātha yathātathaṃ.
segments.tha-ap532:33.3: Tattha tatthūpapannopi [yattha tatthūpapannopi (sī. pī.)], yasassī tena homahaṃ.
segments.tha-ap532:34.3: Vaṇṇayaṃ sukhado āsiṃ, sattānaṃ sukhito tato.
segments.tha-ap532:36.1: “Jino te titthikākiṇṇe [janoghe titthakākiṇṇe (sī. pī.), jino yo titthikātiṇṇo (syā.)], abhibhuyya kutitthiye;
segments.tha-ap532:36.3: Guṇaṃ vadanto jotesiṃ [thomesiṃ (syā.)], nāyakaṃ jutimā tato.
segments.tha-ap532:39.3: Niggahiṃ te saddhammena, paribhūto na tenahaṃ [paribhūtena tenahaṃ (syā.)].
segments.tha-ap532:45.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap532:47.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā sugandho thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.
segments.tha-ap532:51.3: Supaṭo daṇḍadāyī ca, nelapūjī tatheva ca.
